technical.summary: Bullish structure with strong trend confirmation and volume support, but overbought conditions and negative MACD histogram limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: OMC shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 56 days present elevated risk.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (233.28) indicates extreme market stress, CPI event imminent (0 days), and communication services sector faces credit stress in risk-off environment; 56-day earnings window provides moderate buffer but insufficient to offset systemic risks.
